Here's a concise implementation plan for `pairs_sum_to_zero`:

• Use a set to track elements seen so far while iterating through the list, checking if the negation of the current element exists in the set before adding the current element

• For each element, check if its negative counterpart (-element) is already in the set; if found, return True immediately since they would sum to zero

• If the iteration completes without finding any pair that sums to zero, return False
